assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Diagnosis codes are I49.9, R42, and Z86.73
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is ordered to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the source of the patient's symptoms as described in the clinical indication note
